notes: The subject uses thirty-second-note triplets. The short interlude at m. 8 follows the answer; the bass statement ends with an eighth rest in m. 12. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
